name: Task subagent
description: Checks the task tool creates a child session, forwards child events, persists subagent metadata, and returns the child result to the parent.
prompt: TASK_SUBAGENT_SMOKE use the task tool for this smoke test. Delegate exactly one read-only child task. After the task finishes, answer with exactly: Subagent found marker aqua.
